payload.title: Complementary pseudo-coefficient and datum action ensemble
payload.statement: A context-local ensemble of the T025 pseudo-coefficient action and the nearly uncorrelated T016 nested datum action can improve E011 and T025 while repairing each parent’s domain failures, without routing or new inference features.
payload.evidence_for: T029 finds row-centered correlation 0.018136 and a full-data 0.40/0.60 diagnostic at 12.377388 with positive direct OOF gain in all ten domains.
payload.evidence_against: The diagnostic uses full-label weight selection and parent OOF actions whose context isolation differs. Typewell group 4 margin is only 0.001906 for the best pooled all-domain point.
payload.next_test: Execute the committed T030 outer-isolated confirmation without altering branches, grids, controls, aggregation, slices, or gates after the first metric.
